result:
**Verdict: approved.** I found no blocking problems in the 14 XML files (7 Hebrew, 7 English) within the scope you set. Two limits matter. I could only read files, so I compared hashes and Unicode by eye, not by computing them. And I didn't look at the scan images, so the approved working JSONs are my only evidence of what the page prints.
